elo_reproduction.explanation: the lab marks a game neutral when the stadium name differs from the team's usual one; Seattle's rename in 2020 made its last four home games neutral there

closing_line_vs_nflverse_pregame_wp.explanation: nflverse maps spread to win probability with a steeper curve than a normal fitted to earlier seasons' results; the games over 0.3 have the first-play value on the wrong side (nflverse data defect)
